note: Level 1's eight structure kinds' Synty models, as `champions structure bake` spawns them (StructureModel.cs): the prefab by vendor GUID (rhythm_champions/manifest.json; ps-6y2.15's picks), the height in metres from the ground to its top (the model is scaled to it, uniformly; each lies along x as its footprint in Content/structures.json does), children to hide (window glass), how many pieces it shatters into, and the default look's change to it, judged by eye at game scale, with why: a crease angle of its own (over 24 degrees where its lines turn to noise, so only its larger turns draw; under it, down to 1, every edge, where a few big facets are the drawing). `--look trailer` draws the model unsimplified, its creases over 24 degrees as the trailer drew the monsters. A kind with a recipe, tools/recipes/structure/KIND.py (ps-6y2.43), draws its designed low-poly mesh in the default look instead, every edge of it, and its defaultLook goes unused. Tried and rejected (ps-6y2.30): the buildings and the wall at 45 degrees (the cottage's and hut's roof slabs and the wall's stones lose parts of their outlines and break into scratches; the tower's bricks and balconies are square lips, so nothing changes) and decimation (Unity's mesh LODs turn the tower's roof into spikes and the cottage's into jagged scratches).

defaultLook.why: Its leaves are two faceted blobs whose soft creases fall under 24 degrees, so their outline stays open; over 12 the blobs close into a ball of facets without drawing every near-flat diagonal.
A boulder of a few big facets: at 24 degrees only three strokes cross it and its outline stays open; over 8 every facet draws, closed, without the slivers of a near-flat face's triangulation.
